description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release groups recent chats in the sidebar by time, fixes several issues with to-do task conversations and Antigravity failures, and updates Claude Code to 0.110.1, OpenCode to 2.4.1 and other agents.
Improved
- Recent chats in the sidebar are now grouped into In progress, Today, Yesterday, Previous 7 days, Previous 30 days and Older, and a button in the Recent header switches back to a flat list. Your choice is remembered. (#1284, @ana52070)
- Updated Claude Code (claude-agent-acp) to 0.110.1, OpenCode to 2.4.1, Kimi Code to 2.7.3 and DeepSeek to 0.12.0. OpenCode's background image and video generation results now show in the conversation, and DeepSeek's model catalog can be edited again.
Fixed
- To-do task conversations that finished normally no longer show as cancelled.
- Opening a Codex to-do task's conversation right after it finishes now works on the first try instead of showing "connection not found".
- When an Antigravity turn fails, for example because the account's quota ran out or the region isn't supported, the conversation now shows a clear failure message, both live and after reload. Before, the error looked like a normal reply.
Thanks to @ana52070 for contributing to this release.
